strings: High Executor Hadrec is the military commander of the Forsaken garrison stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. From this central crypt, he oversees defense against regional threats including the gnolls of the Rot Hide clan and investigates the disappearance of scouts across the zone. He serves as the primary officer directing Horde operations throughout Silverpine.

Stationed within the gloom of the Sepulcher, High Executor Hadrec directs Forsaken military operations across Silverpine Forest. While Tirisfal Glades is firmly secured by the Dark Lady's forces, Silverpine remains fraught with peril, bordered by hostile Dalaran mages, feral worgen, and encroaching gnolls. Hadrec bears the grim responsibility of consolidating Forsaken territory and stamping out anything that challenges Undercity authority south of the capital.

Much of Hadrec's immediate concern revolves around the Rot Hide gnolls and Fenris Isle. These undead-tainted beasts have infested the Dead Fields and the shores of Lake Lordamere, posing an unpredictable and vicious threat to Forsaken patrols. Hadrec dispatches agents to scour the decrepit ferries and rotting farmsteads for clues, determine what empowers the beasts, and prepare an outright strike against their island stronghold.

Beyond the gnoll infestation, Hadrec closely monitors intelligence gathered by the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken's secretive rogue intelligence arm. When covert operatives disappear near the eerie spires of Shadowfang Keep, Hadrec tasks adventurers with discovering their fate, ensuring the Dark Lady remains informed of the shadowy archmage Arugal and his cursed worgen.

High Inquisitor Fairbanks was once a revered priest of the Knights of the Silver Hand and a trusted advisor to Highlord Alexandros Mograine. Once a prominent spiritual leader among Lordaeron's surviving defenders, his fate became tied to the dark descent of the Scarlet Crusade.

Before the fall of Lordaeron, Fairbanks was a respected holy man among the Knights of the Silver Hand. When Highlord Alexandros Mograine convened a fateful gathering at the Southshore inn, Fairbanks stood beside him, helping channel holy power into the enigmatic crystal that would eventually become the heart of the legendary Ashbringer. When Prince Arthas dissolved the paladin order, Fairbanks accompanied Mograine to Ironforge, standing witness as King Magni Bronzebeard forged the great blade to combat the Scourge.

Fairbanks accompanied Alexandros Mograine when the Highlord's eldest son, Renault, led them into a terrible Scourge ambush outside Stratholme. Fairbanks fell early under the press of undead claws, buried beneath piles of rotting corpses. From this horrific vantage, he silently witnessed Renault seize the fallen Ashbringer and plunge it into his own father's heart, corrupting the holy blade with patricide. Surviving the slaughter, Fairbanks clawed his way out from under the dead and fled back to Hearthglen to expose Renault's treachery.

Fairbanks's desperate warnings shattered the remaining defenders of Lordaeron. Those who believed his horrific account abandoned the fanatical order to form the Argent Dawn. Those who remained loyal to Renault and Saidan Dathrohan branded Fairbanks a blasphemer and a lunatic. Infected by the plague during his time buried under Scourge corpses, Fairbanks was quietly executed by the Scarlet Crusade. Rather than granting him a holy burial, the crusaders discarded his body in a hidden chamber behind the Cathedral's altar, where he eventually rose as the very monstrosity they swore to cleanse.

High Priest Rohan is the preeminent leader of the Church of the Holy Light within Ironforge, found pacing inside the Hall of Mysteries. He oversees the spiritual development of fledgling priests across the Alliance and aids those seeking mastery over the Holy Light. Through his guidance and sacred relics, he maintains spiritual ties between the mountain kingdom, Stormwind, and distant allies.
Shepherd of the Hall of Mysteries

Pacing the quiet flagstones of the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward, High Priest Rohan acts as the highest-ranking representative of the Church of the Holy Light in Ironforge. While dwarves historically honored the titans, dwarven priests have deeply embraced the Light's virtues of wisdom, compassion, and justice. Rohan serves as a patient teacher to young acolytes, teaching them the discipline necessary to channel holy magic and steel their minds against despair.

Rohan recognizes that spiritual insight takes many shapes across the Alliance. Once priests under his tutelage grasp the fundamentals, he directs them outward—sending human and dwarven students to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind City, or dispatching night elf disciples to Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus to master elusive mysteries like Elune's Grace. Beyond the capitals, he urges devotees to render assistance wherever hardship strikes, even directing healers abroad to aid the druids of the Cenarion Circle in distant Azshara.

In addition to his teachings, Rohan holds custody over sacred relics essential to the wider Alliance priesthood and paladin brotherhoods. Among his possessions is a blessed exorcism censer, seasoned through years of cleansing vile spirits. When the Order of the Silver Hand and Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker require the vessel to temper the holy calling of their knights, Rohan freely yields it—asking only for charitable alms to replenish Ironforge's dwindling food reserves for the city's needy.

High Priestess Laurena is a respected human priest trainer stationed behind the grand altar within Stormwind City's Cathedral of Light. Having escaped the destruction of Lordaeron as a refugee during the Third War, she now instructs budding Alliance priests in spiritual devotion and arcane wards.

Before taking her post within the towering halls of the Cathedral of Light, Laurena dwelt in the northern kingdom of Lordaeron. When the Scourge swept across the land during the Third War, she and her entire family were fortunate enough to survive and flee southward, arriving in Stormwind City as displaced refugees. Despite the immense grief and chaos that shattered her homeland, Laurena remained steadfast in her devotion, eventually rising to become a High Priestess in service to the Church of the Holy Light.

Positioned directly behind the central altar within the cathedral sanctuary, High Priestess Laurena dedicates herself to mentoring aspiring priests. When promising acolytes demonstrate sufficient dedication and piety, they are directed to her to deepen their studies. Laurena guides them in the invocation of sacred boons such as Desperate Prayer and instructs them in defensive arts, including spells designed to turn enemy arcane magic back against those who wield it. Once an initiate has learned all she can offer, she sends them onward to other master priests across the Alliance.

Highlord Demitrian is a solitary human hermit dwelling amidst the strange crystals of northwestern Silithus. Describing himself as a loyal servant of Prince Thunderaan, he possesses the esoteric knowledge required to wake the slumbering elemental lord. Adventurers bearing ancient elemental bindings seek him out to unlock the power of the Windseeker.

Found lingering at an abandoned encampment in the Crystal Vale, Demitrian appears out of place in the desolate wastes of Silithus. Though he is tied to the Twilight's Hammer whose ravaged camp he haunts, Demitrian acts above all as a herald for Prince Thunderaan, the Windseeker. He treats visitors with aloof indifference unless they carry proof of the Windseeker's shattered essence.

Demitrian's purpose is tied entirely to Thunderaan's resurrection. Should an adventurer present him with the Bindings of the Windseeker—relics torn from fire elementals within the Molten Core—Demitrian provides the Vessel of Rebirth. He demands rare elemental reagents, including vast quantities of enchanted elementium and the essence of the Firelord, to reconstitute his prince's physical form.

Demitrian's ritual brings Prince Thunderaan into the Crystal Vale, where adventurers must face the restored Windseeker in battle. Once they vanquish the elemental lord, they recover the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade and bring it to the terrified Demitrian, who awakens Thunderfury in exchange.

His merciless discipline has made the Monastery's beasts infamous throughout Tirisfal Glades.

Within the heavily fortified walls of the Scarlet Monastery, Houndmaster Loksey commands the training of vicious tracking and attack dogs. The Scarlet Crusade relies on these trained hounds to sniff out plague-tainted corpses, uncover hidden infiltrators, and run down any survivors fleeing the zealots' wrath. Loksey holds absolute authority over the Armory's kennel wing, ensuring his charges are primed to tear intruders apart limb by limb.
